title: App shell: bottom navigation, floating buttons and header banner (old look) - part 1 of 2 (G-346..G-357; mainly app_shell.dart, shell_fab_layer.dart, pending_booking_fab_provider.dart)

guards.step_title: App shell: bottom navigation, floating buttons and header banner (old look)
guards.situation: The customer taps the tab that is already highlighted (for example "Rezervovat" while filling the booking form at /booking or sitting on /payment, or "Rezervace" inside a reservation detail); in the old look the tap does nothing, so an accidental tap never throws them out of the form or payment.
guards.old_where: lib/core/shell_tab_action.dart:39-44 (only `!isActive || goHome` navigates); highlight from app_shell.dart:30-43 (_currentIndex: /booking and /payment = tab 1); same rule in 70a94933 app_shell.dart:307-308.
guards.customer_sees: Nothing happens; the customer stays on the form / payment.
v2_where: lib/core/v2/shell/app_shell_v2.dart:137-149: _onTab treats a tap as a reselect ONLY when the path equals the tab root; otherwise it calls onShellTabTap with isActive:false, so on /booking or /payment a tap on "Motorky" goes to /search, and inside /reservations/<id> a tap on "Rezervace" goes to the list.
guards.verdict_evidence: v2 passes isActive:false unconditionally (app_shell_v2.dart:149). A running payment is still protected by the confirm (record shell-fabs-01) and the booking draft is kept in memory (no Home reset), but an idle payment screen or the booking form can be left by one tap on the highlighted tab, which the old look ignored. Low impact: other tabs could always leave the form in both looks.

guards.step_title: App shell: bottom navigation, floating buttons and header banner (old look)
guards.situation: MotoGo24 publishes an announcement in Velín (app_settings.header_banner, e.g. closure, weather, outage); the old look shows it as a scrolling coloured band at the very top of every shell screen, in the colours chosen in Velín.
guards.old_where: lib/core/app_shell.dart:74-80 (banner.when -> ShellHeaderBanner when enabled), lib/core/shell_banner.dart:9-26 (bg/colour from Velín, fixed 28 px band, marquee) ; data lib/core/banner_provider.dart:120-202 (realtime + 30 s polling, translation only when fresh).
guards.customer_sees: A fixed coloured marquee strip above the content, always on screen.
v2_where: lib/core/v2/shell/app_shell_v2.dart:157-160,215 (MgTopBanner band, not on / and /search), lib/features/home/v2/home_header_v2.dart:43-44,125-129 and lib/features/catalog/v2/motorky_header_v2.dart:41,70-78 (banner as last line of the header), lib/core/v2/chrome/mg_top_banner.dart:23-67 (text only, tap = full text sheet, folds with hide-on-scroll).
guards.verdict_evidence: Same provider and the same enabled flag, so every announcement still appears, and v2 adds a tap to read the whole text. But: v2 ignores the Velín background/text colours (MgTopBanner takes only text), so a red warning looks like an ordinary line; the band folds away when the content is scrolled (folded: _bars.hidden, app_shell_v2.dart:166,215); on Domů and Motorky it is inside the header and scrolls away with it; it is not drawn when the text is empty (trim().isNotEmpty).
